items.source: Creates a new builder for AnthropicChatModel.
items.translation: 为 AnthropicChatModel 创建一个新的构建器。

items.source: Registers an AnthropicHttpClientBuilderCustomizer that mutates the underlying OkHttp client builder before the Anthropic clients are constructed.
items.translation: 注册一个 AnthropicHttpClientBuilderCustomizer，该自定义器会在构建 Anthropic 客户端之前修改底层的 OkHttp 客户端构建器。

items.source: Sets the full list of customizers to apply, replacing any customizers registered earlier on this builder.
items.translation: 设置要应用的 customizers 完整列表，替换在此构建器上之前注册的任何自定义器。

items.source: Spring AI integration with Anthropic's Claude models using the official Anthropic Java SDK.
items.translation: 使用官方 Anthropic Java SDK 将 Spring AI 与 Anthropic 的 Claude 模型集成。

items.source:
Sets the executor used by the underlying OkHttp dispatcher for both the sync
and async clients.
items.translation: 设置底层 OkHttp 调度器中同步和异步客户端所使用的执行器。

items.source:
Sets the meter registry used to bind OkHttp connection-pool gauges (active/idle
connections).
items.translation: 设置用于绑定 OkHttp 连接池仪表（活动/空闲连接）的计量器注册表。

items.source: Sets the observation registry for metrics and tracing.
items.translation: 设置指标和追踪的观察注册表。
